name: Skyflow Forms – Contact Form Builder, Easy, Modern, and Responsive Form Builder
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Skyflow Forms is a modern, lightweight WordPress form builder that lets anyone create professional, responsive forms in minutes — no coding required.

Whether you need a simple contact form, a multi-step feedback form, or a structured multi-column layout, Skyflow Forms provides a clean drag-and-drop builder with live preview, built-in submission management, email notifications, and an analytics dashboard.

Why Skyflow Forms?

  • Drag-and-drop form builder — Add, reorder, and organize fields visually
  • Multi-column container layouts — Build 1 to 6 column responsive layouts
  • Live form preview — Preview forms on desktop, tablet, and mobile before publishing
  • Email notifications — Admin alerts and user auto-responder with merge tags
  • Submission management — View, filter, star, trash, and export submissions from wp-admin
  • Analytics dashboard — Track submission trends, top forms, and key metrics with built-in charts
  • Global validation messages — Customize error messages site-wide with token support
  • Shortcode ready — Embed forms anywhere with a simple shortcode
  • SMTP compatible — Works with WP Mail SMTP, FluentSMTP, Post SMTP, and any mail plugin

Form Fields (Free)

  • Name (First + Last)
  • Email
  • Text (single line)
  • Textarea (multi-line)
  • Dropdown
  • Radio buttons
  • Checkboxes
  • Phone number
  • Submit button

Advanced Fields (Pro)

Unlock advanced capabilities with Skyflow Forms Pro:

Input & validation
– Mask Input
– Address Fields
– Country List
– Numeric Field
– Multiple Choice
– Website URL
– Time & Date
– Image Upload
– File Upload
– Custom HTML

Compliance & security
– Terms and Conditions
– GDPR Consent
– reCAPTCHA (Google)
– hCAPTCHA

Engagement
– Rating (stars / numeric)

Layout & structure
– Accordion / Tab — group fields in collapsible panels or tabs (nested drop zones, ARIA-friendly frontend)
– Layout / Content Fields — non-submitting blocks with full Input Customization in the builder:
– Section Divider (heading, description, alignment, colors, spacing, CSS class)
– Paragraph (HTML content, alignment, typography, spacing, CSS class)
– Spacer (height, optional mobile height, hide on small screens, margins)
– Image Block (media, alt, size, alignment, caption, link, margins)
– Page Break (step labels, button copy, progress text, multi-step data attributes)

Core Highlights

Visual Form Builder

  • Clean drag-and-drop interface
  • Field reordering controls (move up/down + drag support)
  • Form Name input in the header bar (centered, responsive)
  • Intelligent default form names (“Skyflow Form #1”, auto-incrementing)
  • New forms start with a 1-column container + Submit button
  • Better edit-mode stability for existing forms
  • Improved nested drag-and-drop behavior inside containers

Field Organization

  • Basic Fields — name, email, text, textarea, dropdown, radio, checkbox, phone, submit (free)
  • Advanced Fields — Pro-only inputs and blocks listed under Advanced Fields (Pro) above; cards show a Pro badge when the add-on is inactive
  • Layout / Content Fields — Pro-only Section Divider, Paragraph, Spacer, Image Block, Page Break (saved forms show locked placeholders without Pro)
  • Container — free: 1–6 column layouts; add a container, then drag Basic or (with Pro) Advanced fields into each column; supports nested reorder and save/reload

Container Layouts

  • Add one to six column containers
  • Drop fields into column zones
  • New forms include a default 1-column container
  • Improved nested layout rendering and save/reload consistency

Accordion / Tabs (Pro)

  • Organize fields into collapsible accordion panels or tabbed sections
  • Multiple sections with add/rename/remove/reorder controls
  • Nested dropzones within each section
  • Accordion mode: configurable default open section, allow multiple open
  • Tabs mode: alignment (left/center/right), tab style (underline/pills)
  • Accessible frontend rendering with ARIA attributes and keyboard support

Global Validation Messages

  • Customize default error messages for all field types from Settings
  • Supported message keys: required field, email invalid, numeric invalid, URL invalid, min/max value, min/max selections, date min/max, file type/size/count

Analytics Dashboard

  • KPI cards: Total Submissions, Spam Submissions, Unread Submissions, Created Forms
  • Overview Chart: multi-series line chart (Submissions, Read, Unread, Trashed) rendered with Canvas API
  • Top Performing Forms: horizontal bar chart with submissions tab
  • Date range filtering: Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last 90 days
  • Form-specific filtering

Settings

  • General: Layout Configuration and Validation Messages (accordion cards)
  • Emails: Admin Notification, User Auto-Responder, and Advanced (accordion cards)
  • Security: Google reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha configuration (accordion cards)

Input Customization

  • Global form settings appear when no field is selected
  • Field-specific settings appear when a field is selected
  • Streamlined settings structure: Title, Content, Form Display, Form Note, Background Style

Submissions Management

  • Full submissions list with form filtering
  • Read/unread status tracking
  • Submission detail view with field data
  • Bulk actions (delete, mark read/unread)

Upgrade & Support Pages

  • Upgrade Three pricing plans: Starter ($19.99), Professional ($49.99), Agency ($99.99)

Email Notifications & Merge Tags

Send customized admin notifications and user confirmation emails on every submission. Personalize the subject and body using merge tags.

Upgrade & Support Pages

  • Upgrade Three pricing plans: Starter ($19.99), Professional ($49.99), Agency ($99.99).

Built for Performance

Skyflow Forms loads only what it needs. No bloated frameworks, no unnecessary scripts on pages without forms. Queries are optimized and cached for fast dashboard rendering.

External services

The free plugin works entirely on your site for building forms, storing submissions, and sending email via WordPress. Optional outbound requests happen only when you turn on and use the features below (Skyflow Forms Pro is required for captcha fields in the builder):

  • Google reCAPTCHA — If you configure site/secret keys under Settings > Security and a form includes reCAPTCHA, each submission sends the visitor’s response token to Google’s verification endpoint so Google can validate it. You may check Google Terms of Service & Google Privacy Policy.
  • hCaptcha — If you configure hCaptcha keys and a form includes hCaptcha, verification posts to. Check for hCaptcha Terms of Use & hCaptcha Privacy Policy.

There is no remote service whose sole purpose is license validation inside the free plugin; Pro licensing, if used, is handled by the separate Pro add-on you install from the vendor.
sections.installation:
From WordPress (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for Skyflow Forms.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Skyflow Forms > New Form to start building.

Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from wordpress.org/plugins/skyflow-forms.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

After Activation

  1. Navigate to Skyflow Forms in the admin sidebar.
  2. Click New Form to open the drag-and-drop builder.
  3. Add fields, customize settings, and save your form.
  4. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget.
  5. Configure email notifications under Settings > Emails.
sections.faq:
Is Skyflow Forms free?

Yes. The free version includes all basic fields, container layouts, email notifications, submission management, analytics, and the full form builder. Pro unlocks advanced fields, captcha, ratings, accordion/tabs, and premium analytics.

How do I add a form to my page?

After saving a form, copy the shortcode shown in the form list and paste it into any page, post, or widget area.

Can I create multi-column form layouts?

Yes. Use the Container section in the builder to create 1 to 6 column responsive layouts and drag fields into each column.

How do I set up email notifications?

Go to Skyflow Forms > Settings > Emails. Enable Admin Notification to get notified on submissions. Enable User Auto-Responder to send confirmation emails to the person who submitted the form.

What merge tags are available?

You can use {form_name}, {submission_id}, {submitted_at}, {email}, {first_name}, {last_name}, {all_fields}, {site_name}, {site_url}, and {field:Your Label} in email subjects and bodies.

Can I customize error messages?

Yes. Go to Settings > General > Validation Messages to set global defaults. You can also override messages per field in the builder.

Does it support CAPTCHA?

Yes, with Pro. Configure Google reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha keys under Settings > Security and add the captcha field to any form.

Does the plugin connect to external servers?

Only when you enable and use optional captcha verification (see External services in the description). Form building, storage, and email use your WordPress site and your mail configuration unless you use reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha as above.

What data is sent to Google or hCaptcha?

When a visitor submits a form that includes reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha, the plugin sends the captcha response token (and related verification fields required by each provider’s API) to that provider’s siteverify URL so the response can be checked. No form field contents are sent to those services for that check beyond what their APIs require.

Is it compatible with SMTP plugins?

Yes. Skyflow Forms uses the standard wp_mail() function, so it works seamlessly with WP Mail SMTP, FluentSMTP, Post SMTP, and any other mail plugin.

Where can I view form submissions?

Go to Skyflow Forms > Submissions to view, filter, search, and manage all form entries.

Does it work with my theme?

Skyflow Forms outputs clean, minimal markup that adapts to any properly coded WordPress theme.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Updated WordPress compatibility to 7.0.
  • Added Form Settings alignment controls for form title, description, and footer note.
  • Improved builder preview and frontend form consistency.
  • Added frontend and preview pagination behavior for Pro Page Break fields.
  • Fixed Section Divider frontend spacing and alignment output.
  • Fixed Address Fields option save/restore and frontend rendering for enabled address subfields.
  • Added core dispatch and validation support for Pro Multi-select Dropdown.

1.0.3

  • Builder canvas shows default field labels (e.g. Email, Phone) without opening Input Customization.
  • Fixed PHP 8.1+ deprecations when null reached merge tags and email handling.
  • Submissions CSV: optional column picker; exports include saved form field values.
  • Improved builder Form Settings labels and placeholders for clearer contact-form wording.
  • Added customizable Thank You Message after successful submissions.
  • Added post-submit redirect options: message only, message then redirect, or immediate redirect.
  • Fixed Input Customization sidebar textareas rendering too small in admin.
  • Improved builder drag-and-drop with handles and accurate insertion placeholder between top-level items.

1.0.2

  • Bug fixes and stability improvements.
  • Fixed form builder save and update staying on editor with success notices.
  • Fixed dropdown and radio options not saving inside layout containers.
  • Fixed form content not displaying on the frontend shortcode output.
  • Added preset, solid color, and image backgrounds with opacity controls.

1.0.1

  • Added drag-and-drop container layouts with 1–6 column support.
  • Added email notification system with admin alerts and user auto-responder.
  • Added global validation messages with token support.
  • Added analytics dashboard with KPI cards, charts, and date filtering.
  • Added live preview modal with desktop, tablet, and mobile switcher.
  • Added 5 new Pro fields: Terms & Conditions, GDPR Consent, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Rating.
  • Added Accordion and Tabs layout blocks (Pro).
  • Redesigned Settings page with modern card-based UI.
  • Added Upgrade and Support admin pages.
  • Improved form builder stability, field reordering, and nested drag-and-drop.
  • Fixed frontend rendering issues for placeholders, labels, and container layouts.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
